div.head: Af 30
div.ab: XXIIII. Gif hit sy syxhynde mon, ælc mon to hloðbote LX scll', ond se slaga wer ond fulwite.
XXV. Gif hit sie syxhynde mon, ælc mon to hloðbote LX scill., ⁊ se slaga wer ⁊ fulwite.
Si sit homo sixhindus, unusquisque reddat pro hloþbota LX sol., et percussor weram cum plena wita.
{XXV} Gif hit sie syxhynde mon, ælc mon to hloðbote LX scill, ⁊ se slaga wer ⁊ fulwite.
If it is a 600-[wergild] man, let each man give 60 shillings as compensation for taking part in the band, and the slayer wer and full fine.
If the slain man's wergeld is 600 shillings, each man shall pay 60 shillings for belonging to such a band; and the homicide [shall pay] the wergeld and the full fine.
If it is a man of a six-hundred wergild, each man [is to pay] 60 shillings as compensation for being in that band, and the slayer the wergild and full fine.
Wenn es ein 600[Schilling-]Mann ist, [zahle] jeder Begleiter als Bandenbusse 60 Schill., und der Todtschläger [selbst] Wergeld und Vollstrafe.
If it is a 600[-shilling] man, [let] each companion [pay] 60 shillings as band-compensation, and the slayer [himself] the wergeld and the full fine.
div.note: Whitelock numbers this chapter 30 and gives Liebermann’s number, 30, in brackets.
